t: This is King's Cross St Pancras, a London Underground station on Euston Road. It serves two mainline stations and six lines, and it's the second busiest station on the network. It is also where the King's Cross fire took place in 1987, killing thirty-one people. Colin Townsley, a station officer with Red Watch at Soho Fire Station, died here from smoke inhalation while helping passengers escape. He was the only firefighter killed, and he was posthumously awarded the George Medal for his bravery.
